response.reconstructed_markdown:
The current interest rate for the Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana \(SSY\) is 8.2% per annum for the October–December 2026 quarter. [0]

Key highlights of the scheme:

- Compounding: Interest is calculated annually and credited to the account at the end of each financial year.
- Deposit Limits: Minimum deposit of \\$250 and maximum deposit of \\$1,50,000 per financial year.
- Tax Status: Enjoys EEE \(Exempt\-Exempt\-Exempt\) status where deposits \(under old tax regime\), interest earned, and maturity proceeds are entirely tax\-free. [0] [1] [2]
